item.title: What’s in Rafa Nadal’s diet that fuels a champion?
item.description: Tennis icon Rafa Nadal has disclosed that extra virgin olive oil is a cornerstone of his daily nutrition, a practice he maintains globally. The renowned athlete, celebrated for his unparalleled sporting achievements, recently shared insights into his dietary regimen with Guía Evooleum, emphasising the vital role this quintessential Mediterranean product plays in his routine. item.title: "Out of Mallorca": Hate graffiti targeting foreign homeowners in Mallorca
item.description: A villa owned by German nationals in Santanyi was vandalised with graffiti displaying a shocking hate message. The owner’s gardener sent a video of the graffiti to Jorge Pérez, the sole VOX councillor at Santany town hall, who publicly condemned the act as vandalism.
